name: APVISO MCP Server
description: Enables interaction with the APVISO AI-powered penetration testing platform to manage targets, initiate scans, and retrieve vulnerability findings. It allows developers to integrate security testing workflows directly into MCP-compatible tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
